cells.gaps: The last census on record was counted in 2008. No census in preparation since October 2023 has been found, and no source says none is being prepared.
cells.note: Only the 2008 census is held, outside the ten years, and no preparation of a successor has been found, so no rung is reached. UNFPA's statement that none has been held since 2008 does not say none is being prepared, so not stage 1.
